title: 美国地产市场现四十年罕见锁定效应
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Something is happening in the U.S. housing market that hasn't been true since the 1980s and it helps explain why you can't afford to buy a home.
segments.zh: 美国地产市场正出现自1980年代以来未有的情况，这有助于解释为何你买不起房。

segments.en: Rising mortgage rates in the U.S. they've just gone back above 7 percent, make the monthly payments on a home loan harder to afford.
segments.zh: 美国按揭利率上升，已重回7%以上，使房贷月供更难负担。

segments.en: But mortgage rates that high did not stop Americans from buying and selling lots and lots of houses in past decade.
segments.zh: 但过去十年，如此高的按揭利率并未阻止美国人大量买卖房屋。

segments.en: The issue now is the difference between the rates home buyers have to pay and the 3 percent or 4 percent rates most home owners secured
segments.zh: 现在的问题在于，购房者需支付的利率与多数房主在2022年前锁定的3%或4%利率之间的差距。

segments.en: before 2022. The gap hasn't been this large in almost 40 years. It essentially locks in home owners to their existing homes because of the financial penalty they'd incur if they sold and took out a new mortgage to buy somewhere else.
segments.zh: 这一差距近40年未见。它实质上将房主锁定在现有住房中，因为若出售并申请新贷款另购他处，将面临财务损失。

segments.en: This prevents them from adding new inventory to the market, reducing moves and home sales and probably boosting prices.
segments.zh: 这阻止了他们向市场增加新库存，减少了搬迁和房屋销售，并可能推高价格。

segments.en: The big question is how long will this lock in last? In the 1980s falling interest rates helped shrink the gap.
segments.zh: 关键问题是这种锁定会持续多久？1980年代利率下降帮助缩小了差距。

segments.en: This time, it's likely that 6 percent or 7 percent mortgage rates are the new normal. Meaning the only thing that can reduce the rate differential is more people buying homes and paying the new higher mortgage rates.
segments.zh: 这次，6%或7%的按揭利率可能成为新常态。这意味着唯一能缩小利率差异的是更多人购房并支付新的更高按揭利率。

segments.en: But homes are selling at a historically low pace. Home builders have been doing their part by reducing prices and part by building smaller houses.
segments.zh: 但房屋销售速度处于历史低位。建筑商已通过降价和建造更小房屋来尽一份力。

segments.en: For the first time on record, the median sales prices now lower for new single-family houses than for existing ones.
segments.zh: 有记录以来首次，新建单户住宅的中位销售价格低于现有住宅。
